ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited announced the routine cessation of Smt. Vandana R. Singh as an Independent Director, effective July 26, 2026, due to the completion of her maximum permissible tenure as per the Companies Act, 2013. This is a statutory departure with no immediate red flags, though the company will need to appoint a replacement to maintain robust board governance and regulatory compliance regarding independent director composition.
